title: Two-Ended Configurations Are Seam Configurations
statement: Let $L$ be a natural number, $S$ a state type, $x$ a Boolean input word, $q\in S$, and $s$ a Boolean word. The configuration on $L+1$ work tapes with state $q$, tape zero storing $s$, the last tape blank, both endpoint heads at zero, all intervening tapes blank with heads at zero, input head at position one, and empty output equals the configuration with state $q$, $s$ on tape zero, all other tapes blank, every work-tape head at zero, input head at position one, and empty output.
replaced:
The two-ended administrative configuration with tape zero holding $s$, blank
capture tape, and both endpoint heads at zero equals the canonical seam
configuration carrying $s$ on tape zero.
